name: 2:1 Multiplexer (Data Selector)
objectives: Understand data routing using a Select Line S.
Construct 2:1 MUX using 1 NOT (7404), 2 AND (7408), and 1 OR (7432) gates.
theory: A 2-to-1 Multiplexer selects one of two data inputs (I0 or I1) and routes it to output Y based on Select line S: Y = (S'·I0) + (S·I1).

boolean_equations.Output: Y = (NOT S AND I0) OR (S AND I1)

foundation.title: Foundation (Basic Gates)
foundation.description: Construct 2:1 MUX using NOT (7404), AND (7408), and OR (7432) gate packages.

optimization.description: Rebuild 2:1 MUX using ONLY 4 NAND gates (IC 7400).
